_comment: Ownership-only targets for halal_allocator.py. Weights must sum to 1.0. GOLD-LED: PAXG is one troy oz of allocated physical gold at Paxos — the least contested store of value in Islamic finance, and far less volatile than crypto. BTC is included for growth; most contemporary scholars treat it as an asset rather than a debt instrument, though it is debated. ETH deliberately omitted: at this account size three assets is over-diversification and ETH adds little BTC does not. Set PAXG to 1.0 to hold only the uncontested asset.
